title: 'The system' is a valid automated actor
whyThisCase: Regression for the actor-rule fix. Automated behavior (lock after N failures) correctly uses 'the system' as the actor. Quality scoring must treat this as HasActor=true. Ambiguity detection must NOT flag it as actor-undefined. A numeric bound is present, so this is also not a missing-constraint plant.

mustExtract.note: The automated lock requirement must be extracted.

mustNotDetect.note: Do not flag this as actor-undefined. 'The system' is the intended actor for lockout.

actorChecks.note: HasActor must be true on the extracted lock unit.
